protocol.metric: CUDA event elapsed microseconds / (captured calls * graph replays)
protocol.aggregation: median of six batch means per method; speedup is ratio of medians
protocol.outputs: 64 retained distinct output pairs per method; storage reused across graph replays
protocol.cache_scope: repeated static inputs and output buffers, no explicit cache flush
protocol.worker_policy: one fresh process per shape/dtype, sequential; six within-process timing batches
protocol.scope: warm CUDA Graph replay, before any kernel tuning; not Python-call or model latency
